It's really a great place. Feels like home already. I really do appreciate this new comfort.$h"/pause 500/faceDirection Pam 2/pause 1000/showFrame Pam 25/pause 1000/animate Pam false true 250 26 27/pause 400/emote farmer 8/pause 500/textAboveHead Pam "Oh, Sorry..."/pause 1000/stopAnimation Pam/pause 950/speak Pam "*sniff*...
